labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for Table.title to accept more types, which needs new code.

body:
This asks for `Table.title` to accept more types than `str` and `Text`, so it is a new feature rather than a fix. New features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened.

Related: #4171 raised the same request and was closed as not planned. #2266 covers Rules inside table cells.

If you want a rule at the table's width, `Table.grid` (one of the workarounds you mentioned) can place a `Rule` and a `Table` in one renderable. See [rich/table.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/table.py).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
